description: This file defines a PHP trait named LeaveRequestPermissionTrait within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a method to check if a leave request is accessible to the current user, enforcing access control based on user roles. The trait uses other traits and classes to perform role checks and throw exceptions if access is denied.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the given leave request is accessible to the current user. Throws a LogicException if the trait is not used in an Endpoint class. Verifies if the employee associated with the leave request has accessible permissions, throwing a forbidden exception if access is denied.

search-terms: PHP trait for leave request permissions
